description: AI-orchestrated calendars, contacts & tasks across any DAV platform. 27 tools, field-agnostic.
name: io.github.PhilflowIO/dav-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your CalDAV/CardDAV server (e.g. https://example.com/dav.php/)
environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_SERVER_URL

environmentVariables.description: Password or app-specific password for DAV server authentication
environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Google CalDAV endpoint; required when AUTH_METHOD=oauth2
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SERVER_URL

environmentVariables.description: Google account email; required when AUTH_METHOD=oauth2
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_USER

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client ID; required when AUTH_METHOD=oauth2
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret; required when AUTH_METHOD=oauth2
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 refresh token; required when AUTH_METHOD=oauth2
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 token endpoint; required when AUTH_METHOD=oauth2
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL
